All metadata was taken from responses retrieved in this session (Crossref REST, OpenCitations, arxiv.org/search HTML, PyPI JSON, GitHub REST). Author strings for DOI entries are Crossref family/given names (first 6, then 'et al.'); arXiv authors are as printed on the search results page.
Relevance statements rest on titles, arXiv search-page abstract snippets, PyPI summaries and GitHub descriptions only; nothing here was deep-read. Deep-read before using any item in a novelty claim.

No retrieved work combines controlled mutation of neuron models with multi-protocol electrophysiology fingerprints, refinement-calibrated tolerances, optimised protocol-battery selection and held-out evaluation.
